  workflow_dispatch: {}
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
concurrency:
  group: onesa-public-docs-build
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  documentation:
    name: docs-hosting
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.repository.private == false && github.repository
      == 'DruHustle/onesa-ug' && github.repository_id == '1444746154' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.actor
      == 'DruHustle' && github.triggering_actor == 'DruHustle' && github.run_attempt == '1'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      ONESA_DOCS_SCOPE: public
      ONESA_DOCS_ENVIRONMENT: staging
      ONESA_DOCS_EXPECTED_ENVIRONMENT: staging
      ONESA_DOCS_STATIC_HOSTING: 'true'
      ONESA_DOCS_URL: https://docs.onesa.eu
      ONESA_APPLICATION_URL: https://platform.onesa.eu
      ONESA_DOCS_API_URL: ''
    steps:
    - name: Verify GitHub-hosted execution and actual visibility
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        EXPECTED_PRIVATE: ${{ github.event.repository.private }}
      run: |-
        test "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" = github-hosted
        actual=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --jq '.private')
        test "$actual" = "$EXPECTED_PRIVATE" || { echo 'Visibility changed; dispatch fresh validation under the current policy'; exit 1; }
      working-directory: .
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
        ref: ${{ github.sha }}
        fetch-depth: 0
    - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
    - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1
      with:
        node-version: 24.22.1
    - name: Install locked build dependencies
      run: |
        make install
        python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/docs -p 'test_*.py'
        npm --prefix onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs ci
        npm --prefix onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/chat ci
        cd onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs
        npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Read reviewed cross-project source revisions
      id: docs-sources
      run: |
        python3 - <<'PY'
        import json, os
        from pathlib import Path
        revisions=json.loads(Path('docs/ecosystem/source-revisions.json').read_text())
        with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a') as output:
            output.write('portal=' + revisions['onesa-company-portal']['commit'] + '\n')
            output.write('robot=' + revisions['onesa-ai-robot']['commit'] + '\n')
        PY
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - if: github.event.repository.private == false
      name: Materialize pinned portal contracts from imported history
      run: python3 ../scripts/ci/materialize_docs_source.py --source portal
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - if: github.event.repository.private == false
      name: Materialize pinned robot contracts from imported history
      run: python3 ../scripts/ci/materialize_docs_source.py --source robot
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Verify pinned Portal and Robot source contracts
      if: github.event.repository.private == false
      run: .venv/bin/python scripts/docs/ecosystem.py --portal data/docs-sources/portal --robot data/docs-sources/robot
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Capture fresh synthetic application screenshots
      run: |
        python3 scripts/bootstrap_env.py
        ONESA_CHAT_PORT=3100 ONESA_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3100 docker compose up --build --wait
        node scripts/docs/capture.mjs
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Verify dependency security and build classified public documentation
      run: |
        npm --prefix onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs run test:security
        npm --prefix onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs audit --audit-level=low
        make docs-assets docs-public
        .venv/bin/python scripts/docs/validate.py --staged
        git diff --exit-code -- docs/api/openapi.json docs/diagrams/database.mmd docs/public/examples.md docs/database/SCHEMA.md
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Verify public documentation interactions and accessibility
      run: node scripts/docs/acceptance.mjs > "$RUNNER_TEMP/docs-staging-acceptance.json"
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Qualify production-context public bytes before credentials and restore staging Preview
      run: |
        set -eu
        umask 077
        cp -a onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs/build-public "$RUNNER_TEMP/docs-staging-build"
        ONESA_DOCS_ENVIRONMENT=production npm --prefix onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs run build:public
        ONESA_DOCS_EXPECTED_ENVIRONMENT=production node scripts/docs/acceptance.mjs > "$RUNNER_TEMP/docs-production-acceptance.json"
        cp -a onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs/build-public "$RUNNER_TEMP/docs-production-public"
        rm -rf -- onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs/build-public
        cp -a "$RUNNER_TEMP/docs-staging-build" onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs/build-public
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Build and verify classified protected Docs before provider credentials
      run: |
        ONESA_DOCS_HOSTING=cloudflare-access ONESA_DOCS_STATIC_HOSTING=false ONESA_DOCS_URL=https://docs.engineering.onesa.eu npm --prefix onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs run build:internal
        .venv/bin/python scripts/docs/validate.py
        node scripts/docs/visual-acceptance.mjs
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Verify emitted favicon link and bundled icon
      run: python3 scripts/docs/check_identity.py
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Stop isolated screenshot fixture
      if: always()
      run: docker compose down
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform
    - name: Record local public build checks without hosted authority
      run: .venv/bin/python scripts/docs/build_evidence.py --staging "$RUNNER_TEMP/docs-staging-acceptance.json"
        --production "$RUNNER_TEMP/docs-production-acceptance.json" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/docs-local-build-checks.json"
      working-directory: onesa-ai-platform

      uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
      with:
        name: onesa-public-docs-local-build-checks
        path: ${{ runner.temp }}/docs-local-build-checks.json
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 7
    - name: Upload public site only
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
      with:
        name: onesa-public-docs-staging
        path: onesa-ai-platform/onesa-ai-platform-frontend/apps/docs/build-public/

        retention-days: 7
        include-hidden-files: true
      id: public-site
